title: Clockmaking - How To Make A Clock In The Home Machine Shop - Part 1 - Making The Clock Frames
summary: The first episode of Clickspring's series building a John Wilding skeleton clock from raw stock in a home machine shop. It covers making the frames along with the tools needed for the job.
why: Recommended as an absorbing masterpiece of craftsmanship, often raised in threads about watches and clockmaking.

quote.text: It's also a masterpiece, just in a different medium
